subject: midnight tears poison
fact: Midnight tears is a pale ochre dust from Feywild pollen that kills at midnight when ingested, and darkens upon contact with saliva.
source_quote: Midnight tears. A highly toxic pale ochre dust, made from the pollen of a plant usually found only in the Feywild. [...] The dust stays pale ochre. What darkens it is saliva.

subject: sapphire summoning spell
fact: A rare summoning spell requiring an expensive sapphire that recalls a hidden object to the caster’s hand, regardless of location.
source_quote: It's a summoning spell [...] needs a very expensive sapphire [...] you can put it someplace, you can throw it into a river or whatever. Nobody will find it, and then when you need it back, boom.

subject: high tower key storage
fact: The High Tower keys are not stored on the body but summoned via spell, making physical search ineffective.
source_quote: You don't hide the key on a body where someone can search it. You hide it nowhere at all, and you summon it when the door is in front of you.

subject: book poisoning method
fact: The victim was poisoned by ingesting midnight tears dust that had been applied to pages he licked while reading.
source_quote: Some liquid had gotten onto his finger, and the finger had gone black. [...] The dust reacts on contact with spit, and a man turning pages licks his fingers to do it.

subject: shapeshifter threat
fact: A shapeshifter may be involved, capable of impersonating individuals to evade detection.
source_quote: Keep in mind there are people who can change their form. Shapeshift. Whatever you want to call it.

subject: false Sylvira impersonation
fact: Someone impersonated Sylvira Savikas on the night of the murder, a deception unknown to Kalan until revealed.
source_quote: Is he aware that someone was pretending to be Sylvira Savikas the night of the murder? [...] That is new information.

subject: flora theca research site
fact: The Flora Theca, a subsection of the Pavilion Naturalis in the Great Library, holds botanical knowledge critical to identifying the poison.
source_quote: What there was, Fembris told me, was the Flora Theca, a subsection of the Pavilion Naturalis, inside the Great Library, dedicated to plants, herbs, and other flora.

subject: loket-key mechanism
fact: The key was carried inside a locket worn around the victim’s neck, now missing.
source_quote: The key was in the locket. The locket was around the keeper's neck. The locket was gone.

subject: two-hand investigation theory
fact: Two individuals searched the apartment: one who knew the key’s location, one who did not, suggesting multiple perpetrators or conflicting motives.
source_quote: Two hands had searched that apartment — one that knew exactly where to look, one that didn't.

subject: kalan's alibi timeline
fact: Kalan provided a detailed timeline: 8:00 meeting with Janussi, 10:15 visit to Sylvira, morning inspection, cordon, and doubled guard at the High Tower Library.
source_quote: The eight o'clock meeting where he'd pressed Janussi for more watchers and been refused, the quarter-past-ten visit to Sylvira Savikas... the inspection just after eight, the cordon, the posted watcher...

subject: truth-piercing magic
fact: Kalan possesses a magic capable of detecting lies or revealing hidden truths, usable if suspicion arises.
source_quote: He could sort it out? "Of course I could."

subject: hearth interrogation venue
fact: The suspect Daral Yashenti forced the investigators to meet him at the Hearth, a venue of his choosing to maintain control.
source_quote: Daral was not coming to us. We were to go to the Hearth. [...] the suspect setting the venue, picking the ground, making the famous detectives walk to him.

subject: bookwyrm's dismissal
fact: Bookwyrm officially dismissed Kalan from the case, but he remains involved unofficially, creating internal conflict.
source_quote: Bookwyrm had made it official that he was to be nowhere near it. "Officially," I said. "See, there you go."

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 11th hour of the day, Janussi the philistine’s meeting.
source_quote: The eleven o'clock meeting came out without resistance — Janussi the *philistine*

subject: Sylvira's horns
fact: Sylvira is marked by her horns, the relevant fact in the drow's reference.
source_quote: That's — Sylvira." He said it like the horns were the relevant fact.

subject: book of poetry value
fact: The book of priceless poetry was meant to be understood, not sold.
source_quote: priceless poetry to fund some worthless tome about demonic planes

subject: book reading contradiction
fact: Daral gave Janussi a book to teach its worth, then was enraged when Janussi read it.
source_quote: you gave him a book, you were furious to find him reading it

subject: Bookwyrm's nature
fact: Bookwyrm is a cold-blooded creature who eats her young, like a lizard.
source_quote: There's no telling what's going on in her lizard brain. Cold-blooded, he went on, they eat their young

subject: Whispering Dome
fact: The Whispering Dome is a place where supplicants learn something about themselves through silence.
source_quote: The Dome is where supplicants go to learn something about themselves.

subject: Glabbagool's stillness
fact: Glabbagool answered the question of movement by going perfectly still, embodying wisdom.
source_quote: Glabbagool went still. Not paused. Still. The difference matters.

subject: Glabbagool's form
fact: Glabbagool settled along Zalthir’s forearm like a living armament, with four eyes on his scales.
source_quote: Glabbagool and Zalthir, together now... Four, as it turned out, blinking up from my own scales.

subject: corrosive embrace
fact: Glabbagool’s corrosive embrace dissolves a bound target completely, leaving nothing.
source_quote: It was not a wound. It was dissolution. A target restrained, nothing left to hold by the end of it.

subject: bag of holding
fact: The drow in the bag of holding still needed watching, per Glabbagool’s instinct.
source_quote: the drow in the bag of holding still needed watching

subject: silent communication lesson
fact: Zalthir missed the lesson in silent communication, while Glabbagool mastered it in under a minute.
source_quote: I would have known exactly what Glabbagool's answer meant... But that, apparently, had been the day I was sleeping.

subject: poisoning time
fact: The poison was transferred by licking a finger and turning pages, implicating the book.
source_quote: the poison carried on a book, transferred by a man licking his finger and turning the pages

subject: book of poetry ownership
fact: The book had been in Daral’s collection for years, one of his favorites, given away to make a point.
source_quote: The book had been in his collection for years, he said. One of his favorites.

subject: Zalthir's scales
fact: Glabbagool blended into Zalthir’s scales, appearing as part of him rather than a separate creature.
source_quote: He could blend into me rather than read as a separate creature riding along.

subject: Glabbagool's transformation
fact: Glabbagool chose to attach to Zalthir not for power, but for housekeeping — checking on the drow first.
source_quote: his instinct, at the moment of his own transformation, was housekeeping.

subject: Zalthir's companion
fact: Glabbagool is a sentient ooze who speaks, moves with purpose, and understands silence as wisdom.
source_quote: Glabbagool and Zalthir, together now... He flowed up onto my arm.
